d:
A love that prays only for your happiness Khair Mangdi is Bilal Saeed’s evergreen hit from his album Twelve, featuring Fateh, with music by Dr. Zeus and lyrics by Bilal Saeed himself, now presented with a brand-new video.
It’s a soulful song about loving someone so deeply that all you ever ask for is their well-being, a song that has stayed close to fans’ hearts for years
